NVCW: Har pahilarri lav = this is the first beautiful round (of the soul-bride's wedding) with the Lord-husband. Parvirti karam = the work of becoming absorbed in the effort of repeating the Lord's Name. Drirraia = (the Guru) has made it certain.

O Ram ji! I am a sacrifice to you. (By your grace the Guru has) made the Sikh certain of the work of becoming absorbed in the effort of repeating the Lord's Name (he has urged it upon him). This itself is the first beautiful round (of the soul-bride's wedding) with the Lord-husband.
In the first round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord sets out His Instructions for performing the daily duties of married life.
By the first round the Lord has impressed the duties of wedded life.

This is the first round with the husband who is of the form of Hari: that the Guru, restraining one from evil deeds, has made firm the manner of (karam) the turning towards good deeds. Let us be a sacrifice to Ram ji — or it is an address, O brother!
F82D: Bani = the Guru's bani. Drirrahu = make it firm within the heart. Tajaia = they are forsaken.

O brother! The Guru's bani itself is (for the Sikh) the Veda of Brahma. By the grace of this bani make firm (within your own heart) the religion (of remembering the Lord's Name); (by remembering the Name all) sins are removed.
Instead of the hymns of the Vedas to Brahma, embrace the righteous conduct of Dharma, and renounce sinful actions.
Utter you the hymns of the Guru instead of the Vedas of Brahma and hold fast to this faith to dispel yours sins.

The bani which Brahma utters in the form of the Veda — by the authority of that Veda make firm the religion: so the Guru has said, and he has brought about the forsaking of sins. Let us be a sacrifice to Ram ji.
583J: Simrit nam drirraia = the urging to remember the Lord's Name that the Guru has made — this itself is the Simriti (its teaching) for the Sikh.

O brother! Go on remembering the Lord's Name; make this religion (of human life) firm (within yourself). The urging to remember the Name that the Guru has made — this itself is the Simriti (its teaching) for the Sikh.
Meditate on the Lord's Name; embrace and enshrine the contemplative remembrance of the Naam.
Hold fast to righteousness and contemplate the Lord's Name the Simirtis too inculcate the Name.
Make the religion firm and meditate upon Hari's Name; the Simritis too have made certain the repeating of the Name alone.
W8NT: O brother! Keep this teaching of the perfect Guru in mind at every moment; all sins and vices (by its grace) are removed.
Worship and adore the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, and all your sins shall be dispelled.
Dwell you upon the True Guru, your Perfect Guru, and all yours sins and misdeeds shall depart.
The Satguru who is worthy of worship — through his teaching, worship that Parmesar who is perfect; and those who have worshipped, they have driven away all sins, both the gravest and the ordinary.
ZZ4T: Sahaj anand = the comfort of spiritual poise. Man = within the mind.
O brother! The person within whose mind the Lord's Name begins to feel sweet, that greatly fortunate one keeps the comfort of spiritual poise.
By great good fortune, celestial bliss is attained, and the Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the mind.
Through the greatest good fortune; celestial bliss is obtained and the Lord God seems sweet to the mind.
Those within whose mind the Guru has made the repetition of Hari, Hari feel sweet, to those greatly fortunate ones the bliss of the self has come of itself.

RLVY: Arambh = the beginning. Kaj = the wedding ||1||

Servant Nanak says: to repeat the Lord's Name is itself the first round of the soul-bride's wedding with the Lord-husband. From remembering the Lord's Name alone is the beginning of (the soul-bride's) wedding (with the Lord-husband) fixed. ||1||
Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the first round of the marriage ceremony, the marriage ceremony has begun. ||1||
Slave Nanak proclaims that by the First round the marriage rite has begun.
Sri Guru ji says: this is his first round, in which the beginning of the wedding that is oneness has been set up through the Guru. ||1||
H828: Har doojarri lav = the second beautiful round (of the soul-bride's wedding) with the Lord-husband. Satgur purakh milaia = (the Lord) brought the soul-bride to meet the Guru, the great Purakh. Bal ram jeeo = O Ram ji! I am a sacrifice to you.

O Ram ji! I am a sacrifice to you. This itself is the second beautiful round (of the soul-bride's wedding) with the Lord-husband — that (showing mercy, the soul-bride whom) you bring to meet the Guru, the great Purakh,
In the second round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord leads you to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.
In the second round, the Lord has made me meet the Divine True Guru.
The second round with Hari is this: the Satguru Purakh has joined the seeker to reflection and the other virtues. Let me be a sacrifice to Ram ji.
DUP9: Bhai = from all the fears (of the world). Nirbhau = fearless. Hoe = it becomes. Gavaia = (the Guru) removes it.
(her) mind becomes fearless of all the fears (of the world), and (the Guru) removes the filth of egotism (from within her).
With the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord in the mind, the filth of egotism is eradicated.
By God's fear my mind has become fear-free and the filth of my self conceit is washed off.
From fear the mind became fearless, and the filth of pride has been driven away. Let me be a sacrifice to Ram ji.
P1YV: Bhau = fear. Nirmal bhau = pure fear, reverence and respect. Vekhai = she sees. Hadoore = present, ever at hand, at one's side.
O brother! (The soul-bride who, removing egotism,) sings the Lord's praises, within her reverence and respect (for the Lord-husband) is born, and she sees the Lord dwelling at her own side.
In the Fear of God, the Immaculate Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and behold the Lord's Presence before you.
By having the fear of immaculate God, the Master and singing His praise, I behold Him face to face.
The fear of Parmesar which makes one pure — that has been obtained, and for this very reason the qualities of Hari have been sung, and Hari Ram ji has been seen face to face.
PV04: Aatam ram pasaria = the Lord is spreading out the expanse of his own self! Sarab = within all beings. Bharpoore = pervading.
(She becomes certain that this expanse of the world) is the Lord spreading out the expanse of his own self, and that master-Lord is pervading within all beings.
The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is the Lord and Master of the Universe; He is pervading and permeating everywhere, fully filling all spaces.
God Lord master, the soul of the world, is pervading every where and filling all the places.

Hari, (aatam ram) the master, has spread out this world, and having spread it he is again (bharpoore) complete within all — the meaning being that having himself made the creation he is himself dwelling within it.
L1YC: Eko = one alone. Mil har jan = joining with the saintly people, joining in the holy congregation. Mangal = songs of praise.
(To that soul-bride) within herself and without (in the whole world) only the Lord (appears to dwell); joining in the holy congregation she goes on singing the songs of the Lord's praise.
Deep within, and outside as well, there is only the One Lord God. Meeting together, the humble servants of the Lord sing the songs of joy.
Within and without is the One Lord Master. Meeting with the Lord's slaves sing I the songs of joy.
That Hari the all-powerful is one alone (antar) within the body and (bahar) in the universe; joining with Hari's devotees she has sung his songs of rejoicing.
W9G2: Chalaee = set in motion. Anhad = unbroken, without being played. Sabad vajae = he sounds, as it were, the instruments of the bani of praise ||2||

O servant Nanak! (Say — to take the Guru's refuge, to remove egotism, to sing the songs of the Lord's praise and to see him pervading everywhere — the Lord has) set this second round (of the soul-bride's wedding) in motion; (within the soul-bride who has reached this spiritual state, the Lord) sounds, as it were, the unbroken instruments of the bani of praise. ||2||
Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the second round of the marriage ceremony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||2||
Proclaims slave Nanak, the second round is finished and the Divine melody resounds.
Sri Guru ji says: this second round has been set in motion, in that they sound the disposition upon (sabad) Brahm unbrokenly — the meaning being, they reflect upon him. ||2||
FCYN: Teejarri lav = the third beautiful round. Har teejarri lav = the third beautiful round (of the soul-bride's wedding) with the Lord-husband. Man = within the mind. Bairageea man = within the minds of the detached ones. Chau = eagerness (for union with the Lord).

O Ram ji! I am a sacrifice to you. (By your grace) within the minds of the detached ones a longing (for union with you) is born; (this spiritual state is) the third beautiful round (of the soul-bride's wedding with the Lord-husband).
In the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love.
In the third round, the pleasure of Lord's Love wells up within my mind.
That love which has arisen within the minds of the detached ones — this itself is the third round with Hari. Let me be a sacrifice to Ram ji.
XK9T: Mel = union. Vadbhageea = greatly fortunate people.
O brother! Those greatly fortunate people who obtain the company of the saintly ones, they obtain union with the Lord.
Meeting with the humble Saints of the Lord, I have found the Lord, by great good fortune.
Meeting with the holy persons, I have found the Lord God through the greatest good lick.
By joining Hari's company with the saints, the greatly fortunate have obtained Hari. Let me be a sacrifice to Ram ji.
UKCF: Mukh = with the mouth. Bolee = uttered. Har bani = the bani of the Lord's praise.
(Those people) obtain union with the Lord who makes (life) pure, they sing the Lord's qualities for ever, and with their mouths they utter the bani of the Lord's praise.
I have found the Immaculate Lord, and I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. I speak the Word of the Lord's Bani.
Singing God's praise and uttering the Divine Gurbani with my mouth I have obtained the immaculate Lord.
When the qualities of Hari were sung, then the pure Name of Hari was obtained, and with the mouth too only the bani concerning Hari was spoken.
8MRB: Katheeai = it ought to be spoken. Akath = the one whose true form cannot be described. Akath kahani = the praise of the indescribable Lord.
Those greatly fortunate people obtain union with the Lord in the company of the saintly ones. O brother! The praise of the indescribable Lord ought to be spoken for ever.
By great good fortune, I have found the humble Saints, and I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.
By great good fortune, the pious persons attain to God and utter His unutterable story.
That company of the saintly people has been obtained by those with the highest deeds, where the indescribable tales of Hari are told.
F4WS: Hirdai = within the heart. Dhun = a current, a longing. Japeeai = it can be repeated. Mastak = upon the forehead. Bhag = good fortune.

(The person who goes on praising the Lord, within his) heart the ever-abiding current of the Lord's love begins to flow. But, O brother! The Lord's Name can be repeated (only) when good fortune awakens upon the forehead.
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, vibrates and resounds within my heart; meditating on the Lord, I have realized the destiny inscribed upon my forehead.
Within my mind has welled up the music of Good, the Lord Master, and by the destiny recorded on my brow, I contemplate the Lord.

Within the hearts of those who have repeated Hari's Name, the current of devotion to Hari has arisen — the meaning being, a disposition turned towards the self has been born. But Hari is repeated only when a great and high fortune is upon the being's forehead.
MG11: Nanak bole = Nanak speaks. Teeji lavai = through the third round, at the time of the third round of the soul-bride's wedding with the Lord-husband. Man = within the mind (of the soul-bride). Har bairag = the keen longing for union with the Lord. Upjai = it is born ||3||

O brother! Servant Nanak says that at the time of the third round (of the soul-bride's wedding with the Lord-husband) a keen longing for union with the Lord is born within the mind (of the soul-bride). ||3||
Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love for the Lord. ||3||
Says servant Nanak that in the third round God's love is produced in my mind.
Sri Guru ji says: detachment arises in the mind for the attaining of Hari, and he repeats the Name — this is the third round. ||3||
DE9B: Chautharri lav = the fourth beautiful round. Har chautharri lav = the fourth beautiful round (of the soul-bride's wedding) with the Lord-husband. Man = within the mind (of the soul-bride). Sahaj = spiritual poise.

O beautiful Ram! I am a sacrifice to you. (By your mercy, the soul-bride within whose) mind spiritual poise is born, she obtains your union. (This spiritual state is) the fourth beautiful round (of the soul-bride's union with the Lord-husband).
In the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, my mind has become peaceful; I have found the Lord.
In the forth round Divine comprehension has welled up within my mind and I have obtained my Lord.
The fourth round with Hari is this, that knowledge has arisen in the mind, by which the form of Hari has been obtained. Let us be a sacrifice to Ram ji.
4ZZ1: Gurmukh = with the face turned towards the Guru, remaining before the Guru. Subhae = settling in (the Lord's) love. Man = within the mind. Tan = within the body.
O brother! Taking the Guru's refuge and settling in (the Lord's) love, (the soul-bride to whom the Lord) is met, within (her) mind and within (her) body the Lord begins to feel dear.
As Gurmukh, I have met Him, with intuitive ease; the Lord seems so sweet to my mind and body.
By Guru's grace, I have easily met my Lord, who is sweet to my soul and body, To my Lord I am a sacrifice.
The Guru who is the chief has been met quite naturally, and it is that Guru who has made Hari feel sweet within mind and body. Let me be a sacrifice to Ram ji.
LYNC: Prabh bhaia = he became dear to the Lord. Andin = {अनुदिनां} every day, at every moment. Liv laee = he kept his consciousness joined.
O brother! The being to whom the Lord begins to feel dear, that being begins to feel dear to the Lord. That person keeps his consciousness joined for ever in the Lord's remembrance.
The Lord seems so sweet; I am pleasing to my God. Night and day, I lovingly focus my consciousness on the Lord.
God seems sweet to me and I have become pleasing to my Master. Night and day I fix my attention on the Lord.
The one to whom the Gurus made Hari feel sweet, and who became dear to my Lord Hari, that seeker has kept his disposition fixed on Hari night and day.
PMEG: Man chindia = wished for by the mind. Nam = through the Name. Vajee vadhaee = a state of rising spirits came about.
That person obtains the wished-for fruit of union with the Lord. By the grace of the Lord's Name (within him) a state of rising spirits remains for ever.
I have obtained my Lord and Master, the fruit of my mind's desires. The Lord's Name resounds and resonates.
I have obtained my heart-desired fruit, my Lord. By exalting God's name I am congratulated.

Hari, who is of the form of the master, has been met through the Name — this itself is the obtaining of the fruit wished for by the mind; and through this the congratulation sounded, the meaning being that joy became manifest.
H6H3: Prabh = the Lord. Thakur = the master. Kaj = the effort of (the soul-bride's) wedding. Rachaia = he began it. Dhan = the soul-bride. Hirdai = within the heart. Nam = by the grace of the Name. Vigasee = she blossomed, she became filled with bliss.
O brother! The Lord, the master-Hari, (the soul-bride whose) wedding effort he began, that soul-bride, by the grace of remembering the Name, remains filled with bliss for ever within (her own) heart.
The Lord God, my Lord and Master, blends with His bride, and her heart blossoms forth in the Naam.
God, the Lord Master has brought about the wedding ceremony and the bride's mind has blossomed with the Lord's Name.
When the Gurus set up the wedding that is the attaining of Hari the all-powerful master, then the seeker who is the bride, repeating the Name within the heart, became glad.
32V1: Chauthi lavai = at the time of the fourth round of the soul-bride's wedding with the Lord-husband. Avinasi = the one who is never destroyed ||4||2||
Servant Nanak says: at the time of the fourth round of the soul-bride's wedding with the Lord-husband, the soul-bride obtains union with the Lord who is never destroyed. ||4||2||
Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, we have found the Eternal Lord God. ||4||2||
Says slave Nanak, in the fourth circling I have attained to my imperishable God Lord.

Sri Guru ji says: in the fourth (lavai) round, that is, in that stage, the imperishable Lord, the bridegroom of the form of Hari, was obtained — the meaning being, she became one with her own form. ||4||2|| ☬ Making firm the meaning spoken in the previous verse, he describes the state of the one who has knowledge:
